software.this_slice: Test fixtures and evidence only; Node syntax, scoped Prettier, root/golden_core cargo fmt and scoped diff checks. No app binary change.

fixture_corrections: Backend deletion previously settled before the rendered grid. The fixture now waits exact mounted row/header/Cell counts, checks actual button actionability, then captures each empty-axis state.

The inherited single-move drag was intermittent in WebView2, even after draggable=true. A temporary trusted-event trace altered the outcome and was removed. The final fixture uses Playwright's documented two target-hover sequence to deliver dragover, waits source readiness and always releases the mouse. Backend parent and exact Undo assertions are unchanged; no synthetic DOM drag events, forced actions, retries or backend move substitute the gesture.
